name: Nominosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in a shartegosuchid/shartegosuchoid group that has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Nominosuchus is a small protosuchian-grade crocodyliform from Late Jurassic lake deposits of Mongolia and China.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: PIN 4174/4, a partial skull, from the Ulan Malgait Formation, Mongolia.
material: Several specimens from the Ulan Malgait Formation and one from the Qigu Formation, China.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Efimov 1996

sources.text: M. B. Efimov. 1996. The Jurassic crocodylomorphs of inner Asia. The Continental Jurassic. Museum of Northern Arizona Bulletin 60:305-310

Dollman, Kathleen N.; Clark, James M.; Norell, Mark A.; Xing, Xu; Choiniere, Jonah N. 2018. Convergent Evolution of a Eusuchian-Type Secondary Palate within Shartegosuchidae. American Museum Novitates 3901(3901): 1–23. doi:10.1206/3901.1

dates_note: PBDB occurrences span the Late Oxfordian-Kimmeridgian Qigu Formation to the Tithonian Ulan Malgait Formation; interval names set from the formation ages (PBDB gives none for the genus).
